notes.title: AWCA 3.0!
notes.content:
That's right, version 3.0 of A Wild Catgirl appears will be here soon!

The updates include -

Fixed CG's!
One new CG!
Native 1080p resolution
Rebuilt in Ren'py
Volume controls!
Less glitchy weirdness!

All in all, a better game. Expect it at some point between Friday the 2nd and Saturday the 3rd!

I hope you all enjoy it :)

notes.title: Final patch incoming + Sequel poll!
notes.content:
Hi guys!

So, firstly, a new patch will be incoming this next week or so. If my current tests are anything to go by, this will solve save issues, allow for multi-platform play and add an auto-read function to the game.

It will also change the font, which will now make it clear which thoughts are 'inner monologue' as opposed to spoken dialogue. This was there all along, but a font error stopped it from displaying.

Next, as I work on concepts for the next game, I wondered if a spiritual sequel of sorts would be appreciated? A visual novel / JRPG hybrid (Think perhaps Final Fantasy VI with Fire Emblem:Fates style cutscenes).

I've created a poll. Your feedback means a lot to me! Thanks!

http://strawpoll.me/7411286

Kieran
NewWestGames

notes.title: UPDATE! Full remake & postmortem.
notes.content:
Hello everyone,

I wanted to update you regarding future plans for AWCA.

Firstly, the CG artwork is being re-done completely. I know this was a major complaint.

Second, this will be included with a brand new engine, which I've been testing for the past couple of weeks (and is now bug free!). This will include a skip feature, among other important fixes. This will also allow us to easily release a Mac build for the game, as well as 32-bit compatible builds.

Lastly, some additional scenes and dialogue will be included. The endings are a little abrupt, and I'd like to give some more background to the characters.

Thank you for your patience as I make these improvements. Expect more details and a release window shortly. Just to confirm, this is a free update. It won't turn it into a game with the size and scope of Steins;Gate (which contrary to popular belief, I have played!) but will dramatically improve the experience.

Lastly, I shared some thoughts about the release on my website, which you can find here - http://newwestgames.com/2016/01/12/a-wild-postmorten-appears/

Thank you all for your patience.
